propositions: A transient GitHub git fetch hang in the review bot's snapshot operation causes subprocess.TimeoutExpired to be converted to SnapshotFetchError and then caught by adapter.code_review_decision's blanket exception handler, which maps it to a spurious BLOCK with LLM-Review -1 vote.

The spurious -1 vote removes the change from backfill reconciler's re-drive pool because reconcile.once pre-filters on already_voted and has_llm_review_vote, permanently suppressing the safety net without manual re-trigger.

Infrastructure faults (git timeout, connection error, transport stall) fire within the 300s _GIT_TIMEOUT before the outer 1200s REVIEW_TIMEOUT_SECONDS, guaranteeing they take the vote-bearing path instead of the benign no-vote deferral path that already handles hung reviews correctly.

The fix classifies retryable infrastructure exceptions (SnapshotFetchError, subprocess.TimeoutExpired, TimeoutError, ConnectionError) and returns ABSTAIN result instead of BLOCK, preventing vote and dedup row from being written.
An abstained change remains vote-less and is re-picked by backfill on the next reconcile pass, restoring self-healing behavior without requiring manual maintainer intervention.
